items.title: Russian court's in-absentia arrest order for former Ukrainian defence minister takes effect
items.summary: Russian court documents reportedly show that an in-absentia arrest order against former Ukrainian defence minister Oleksii Reznikov has entered into force. Russian authorities accuse him of particularly serious crimes against civilians in Donbas; the order reflects Russian legal proceedings, not a conviction.

items.title: Zelensky declines to explain why Trump reportedly blames him for the war
items.summary: Asked why US President Donald Trump continues to blame him for the war and says he should consider stepping down, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky replied that he thinks he knows the reason but is unsure whether he should discuss it openly. He did not elaborate in the quoted exchange.
